name: Opportunity Cost for Military Primary Care
tone: Evidence-first academic analysis; clear labels and explicit source limits.

layout.paper: Anonymous body; separate title page, figure pages, and bibliography.
layout.lab: Responsive input and results panels; labels and numbers accompany color.

rules: Use the project title consistently in portfolio navigation.
Preserve author prose and historical draft contents.
Figures must identify scenario, source limits, units, and discount assumptions.
Red in the pension visual indicates proximity to eligibility, not advice to remain in service.

paper.body_limit: 4 pages; excludes title page, graphs, bibliography, and appendix
paper.status: condensed draft still requires formatting and author revision

current_figure.scenario: O-4, San Diego internal medicine, 5% real year-end discounting

pension_visual.meaning: Nearer to 20 eligible active years; conditional pension component only

layout.figure: Three specialty panels, four annual points each
layout.axis: Cumulative civilian benchmark minus Navy cash; zero line in every panel
layout.scale: Panel-specific dollar scales, disclosed in caption
layout.caption: Source years, constant-dollar assumption, Marit comparability limit, and no retention effect claim

rules: Every plotted point reconciles to the 12-row CSV.
Use the same color for each policy across all specialty panels.
Label negative cash gaps as Navy above the published benchmark.
The figure must remain legible when exported for the paper.
Do not imply that closing a pay gap measures retention or labor-supply elasticity.
